ticket.title: Webhook 401 after secret rotation
ticket.body: Our endpoint started returning 401 after we rotated the signing secret. We parse the JSON and serialize it again before checking X-Harbor-Signature. Will Harbor retry these deliveries, and what should we check?

review.note: Demonstration review by build agent against example documentation. Escalated because all3 runtime attempts failed verbatim citation validation. The model combined separate policy sentences in one quote. No reply approved; a reviewer should verify the webhook guidance and provide properly sourced wording.

resolution.summary: Customer reports receiving 401 errors after rotating the signing secret. They parse and re-serialize JSON before verifying the X-Harbor-Signature header. They ask if Harbor retries these deliveries and what to check.
resolution.draft_reply: After rotating a signing secret, update the receiver's configured secret. A 401 response is not retried; first check the configured signing secret and verify the original request-body bytes. Please confirm you have updated the secret and are verifying the unmodified request bytes.
resolution.follow_up_question: Have you updated the receiver's configured signing secret following the rotation?

reasons: No accepted structured resolution; review the actual model trace
The runtime did not accept a valid resolution

citations.quote: After rotating a signing secret, update the receiver's configured secret. A 401 response is not retried: first check the configured signing secret and verification of the original request-body bytes.
